name: hustlehub-static-analysis
description: Static code analysis for HustleHub+: SonarJS (the rule engine behind SonarQube/SonarCloud) and eslint-plugin-security, run over the API and the React client.

scripts.report: cd .. && eslint --config static-analysis/eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings 0 --format json --output-file static-analysis/reports/static-analysis-report.json api client/src
